sections.h: 1. Who we are and what this policy covers

blocks.x: This Privacy Policy explains how Theorem JUPEB / CBT App (“Theorem”, “we”, “us” or “our”) collects, uses, shares, stores and protects personal data when you use our Android app, our website at theoremacademia.com, our study materials, practice tools and exam features.
Theorem is operated by TheoremAcademia, which is the data controller for the personal data described here. You can reach us at theoremacademia@gmail.com or on WhatsApp at 0814 913 2093.
We process personal data in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA) and its implementing directives. This policy should be read together with our Terms of Service.

Theorem is for people aged 16 and over. If you are 16 or 17, you may use Theorem only with the permission of a parent or legal guardian, who should read this policy with you. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 16. If we learn that we have, we will delete the account and its data. If you believe a child under 16 has registered, please email us.
The data we process depends on the features you use.

x: Account data: your email address, the name and avatar you choose for your profile, and sign-in session information.
Study setup data: your selected track, university and subject combination, and any request to change a confirmed combination.
Learning and assessment data: practice and exam attempts, answers submitted, scores, exam history, time taken, accuracy, and analytics derived from this activity.
Bookmarks and preferences: items you bookmark and your app settings, including theme.

Payment data: your Paystack transaction reference, payment status, amount and the date premium access was granted. We do not receive or store your card number, expiry date or CVV. These are entered on Paystack’s checkout and handled by Paystack.
Device and technical data: device model, operating system and version, app version, language, push-notification token, crash reports, error logs and the usage events described in section 7.
Support data: the messages and details you send us when you contact support.

blocks.x: We do not ask for your phone number, location, contacts, photos or government ID to use Theorem. Our website does not use cookies or similar tracking technologies.
Providing account, study setup and learning data is necessary to use the app. If you do not provide it, we cannot create your account or provide the service.

sections.h: 4. How we use your data and why

blocks.x: For each purpose below, we list the data we use and our lawful basis under the NDPA.

x: Creating and securing your account, signing you in and keeping sessions safe. Data: account and device data. Lawful basis: contract.
Delivering notes, past questions and practice questions, and saving subject combinations, bookmarks and exam history. Data: account, study setup and learning data. Lawful basis: contract.
Grading exams and showing analytics and personalised recommendations such as weak topics. Data: learning data. Lawful basis: contract, and our legitimate interest in giving useful study guidance.
Processing premium purchases, confirming access and resolving payment issues. Data: payment data. Lawful basis: contract, and legal obligation (accounting records).
Responding to support requests. Data: support data and related account data. Lawful basis: contract and legitimate interest.
Sending account, security and payment notices and service push notifications. Data: account data and push token. Lawful basis: contract and legitimate interest.
Sending promotional notifications and messages about new content, features and offers. Data: push token and email. Lawful basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
Fixing bugs, monitoring stability and understanding how the app is used so we can improve it. Data: device, crash and usage data. Lawful basis: legitimate interest.

Preventing fraud and abuse, preventing one account’s data from appearing to another user, and enforcing our Terms. Data: account, device and payment data. Lawful basis: legitimate interest and legal obligation.

blocks.x: Personalised recommendations and grading are based only on your study activity inside Theorem. We do not make decisions about you that have legal or similarly significant effects by purely automated means.
We do not sell your personal data, and we do not share it with third parties for advertising.

sections.h: 5. Study content, premium access and offline use

blocks.x: The app retrieves subjects, topics, notes and questions from our content service. Some content is restricted to premium users. Premium access is currently a one-time payment of ₦4,000 for nine months. Our server checks the payment confirmation from Paystack before granting access. Content files and images may be delivered through temporary signed links that expire after a short time.

Theorem can work offline. To do this, the app stores study content and some of your data, such as bookmarks and unsent exam answers, on your device. This data stays on your device until it is synced with our servers, you clear the app’s storage, or you sign out or delete your account. Please protect your device with a screen lock.
We share personal data only with service providers that help us run Theorem, and only as needed for their role.

x: Supabase (database region: Frankfurt, Germany): authentication and account-related data such as profiles and bookmarks.
Vercel: hosting of our content-management service and API, which handles learning content, exam submissions, grading and exam history.
Paystack: payment checkout and confirmation. Paystack handles your card or bank details under its own privacy policy and acts independently for that data.
Firebase (Google): delivery of push notifications and app usage analytics.
Sentry: crash and error reporting, which may include device and app-version information.

blocks.x: These providers process data on our behalf under their own security commitments and terms. We may also disclose personal data where the law requires it, where we receive a lawful request from a competent authority, or where needed to protect the rights, safety or security of our users or the service. If Theorem is ever transferred to another operator, we will make sure your data stays protected and we will notify you before it becomes subject to a different policy.
Theorem has no public profiles, leaderboards or community features. Other users cannot see your name, avatar, scores or exam history.

Analytics and crash reports. We use Firebase and Sentry to understand which features are used and to find and fix errors. These tools may collect an app instance identifier, device and operating-system information, app version, and events such as screens viewed. We do not use them to build advertising profiles, and we do not use your study answers or email address as analytics events.

Push notifications. If you allow notifications, the app registers your device’s push token with us so we can send you notifications. Service notifications, such as account, payment and exam-related notices, are sent because they are part of the service. Promotional notifications are sent only if you have opted in. You can turn off notifications at any time in your device settings or in the app. Signing out removes the device’s push registration from your account.

With your consent, we may send you promotional notifications or emails about new study content, features and offers. Every promotional email includes an unsubscribe link. You can opt out of promotional notifications in the app or your device settings. Opting out will not stop service messages that we need to send about your account, security or payments.

Our main database is hosted in Frankfurt, Germany. Our other providers, including Vercel, Google (Firebase), Sentry and Paystack, operate global infrastructure, so your data may also be processed in other countries, including outside Nigeria. Where we transfer personal data abroad, we rely on safeguards required by the NDPA, such as the provider’s contractual data-protection commitments, security standards and, where applicable, recognised transfer mechanisms. You can contact us for more information about these safeguards.

sections.h: 10. How long we keep your data

x: Account, profile, bookmarks, study setup and exam history: while your account is active, and deleted within 30 days after you delete your account.
Accounts inactive for 24 months: deleted after we email you a notice and you do not return.
Backups: deleted data is removed from backups within 90 days.
Payment records (reference, status, amount and date): up to 6 years, for accounting, tax and dispute purposes, even after account deletion.
Support messages: up to 24 months after the issue is resolved.
Crash and error logs: up to 90 days.
Analytics data: up to 14 months.
Push tokens: until you sign out, delete your account, or the token becomes invalid.

blocks.x: We may keep data for longer where the law requires it or where we need it to establish, exercise or defend legal claims. After the retention period ends, we delete the data or anonymise it so it can no longer identify you.
Under the NDPA, you have the right to:

x: be informed about how we use your personal data;
access your personal data and get a copy of it;
ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data;
ask us to delete your data;
ask us to restrict the processing of your data;
object to processing based on our legitimate interests, and to direct marketing;
receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format, where applicable;
withdraw consent at any time, without affecting processing that happened before you withdrew it; and
not be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that has legal or similarly significant effects on you.

blocks.x: To use any of these rights, email theoremacademia@gmail.com from the address on your account, or message us on WhatsApp. We may need to verify your identity first. We will respond within 30 days. If we cannot act on your request, we will explain why.
If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, please contact us first so we can try to fix it. You also have the right to complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC).

You can delete your account in the app under Profile → Delete my account. If you cannot use the app, you can request deletion by emailing theoremacademia@gmail.com from your account email address, or by using the account-deletion request page linked on our website.

When you delete your account, we delete your exam history, push tokens, profile, bookmarks and sign-in account from our systems within 30 days, subject to the backup period in section 10. We keep payment records for the period stated in section 10. Deleting your account ends your premium access, does not cancel or refund a completed payment on its own, and cannot be undone. If you have a payment problem, contact us before you delete your account so we can find your transaction.

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), access controls and server-side checks that link data to the right student, temporary signed links for protected content, and server-side verification of payments. The app clears cached account-specific content when you sign out and resets account-specific data when a different user signs in.
No online service can be completely secure. Please keep your sign-in details private, sign out on shared devices, and tell us promptly at theoremacademia@gmail.com if you suspect unauthorised access.

If a personal data breach is likely to put your rights and freedoms at risk, we will notify the NDPC within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, and we will tell affected users without undue delay where the risk to them is high.

We may update this policy when the app, our providers or the law change. The latest version is always available at https://www.theoremacademia.com/legal/privacy-policy, with the “Last updated” date at the top. If we make a material change, such as using your data for a new purpose, we will notify you in the app or by email before the change takes effect. Where the law requires your consent, we will ask for it again.
For privacy questions and requests: Email: theoremacademia@gmail.com. WhatsApp support: 0814 913 2093. Operator: TheoremAcademia.

Theorem JUPEB / CBT App is intended to support learning and exam preparation through study notes, past questions, practice questions, exam simulations and performance analytics.

sections.h: No official affiliation unless expressly stated

blocks.x: Unless we explicitly state otherwise in writing, Theorem should not be understood to be an official JUPEB examination body, university, admissions authority or government service. The app’s questions, model answers and explanations are study resources and are not a representation that the same questions will appear in an actual examination.

Using the app does not guarantee a particular score, JUPEB result, admission, scholarship or university placement. Results depend on many factors, including a student’s preparation and official examination and admissions decisions.

We aim to provide useful educational material, but errors, omissions, outdated information or differences in interpretation may occur. Students should check important requirements and official examination or admissions information with the relevant authority.

Scores, accuracy, time measurements and subject-performance summaries are learning aids based on activity recorded by the app. They are not official grades or a definitive measure of a student’s ability.
To report an apparent content error, email theoremacademia@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp at 0814 913 2093.
Theorem currently sells premium access as a one-time payment of ₦4,000 for nine months. The amount and duration shown at checkout apply to your purchase.

Payments are made through Paystack. Premium access is granted only after our server receives and verifies the payment confirmation. If you believe you paid successfully but premium access has not been activated, email theoremacademia@gmail.com with your account email, transaction reference, payment date and amount. Do not send your password or full card details.
We will refund you in full in these cases:

x: Duplicate payment: you were charged more than once for the same premium period.
Debited but not activated: your payment was successful and debited, but premium access was not activated and we could not fix it within 7 days of your report.
Fault on our side: a technical fault in the service prevents you from using premium content and we cannot fix it within 7 days of your report.
Accidental purchase: you ask for a refund within 24 hours of paying and have not opened any premium content.

blocks.x: For duplicate payments and debited-but-not-activated payments, please make your request within 30 days of the payment date. For the other cases, make it within the time stated above.

We also do not refund for dissatisfaction with exam results, for unused time after your account is suspended or ended for breaking our Terms, for premium time that has expired, or because you deleted your account. This does not affect any rights you have under the law that cannot be excluded.

This policy does not remove rights that cannot legally be excluded. Contact theoremacademia@gmail.com or WhatsApp 0814 913 2093 with questions. The current version is published at https://www.theoremacademia.com/legal/refund-cancellation-policy.

sections.h: 1. Delete your account in the app

blocks.x: Open the Theorem app, go to Profile and tap “Delete my account”, then confirm. You need to be signed in and connected to the internet. Deletion cannot be undone.

If you cannot use the app, for example because you lost access to your device or uninstalled it, email theoremacademia@gmail.com from the email address linked to your Theorem account. Use the subject “Delete my Theorem account” and say that you want your account and data deleted. We may ask you to confirm your identity before we act. We will confirm by email once your account has been deleted.
Please do not include your password or card details in your request.
When your request is approved, we delete the following from our systems within 30 days:

x: your sign-in account and email address;
your profile, including your name and avatar;
your subject combination and study setup;
your bookmarks and app preferences;
your exam history, answers and analytics; and
your push-notification tokens.

blocks.x: Deleted data is removed from our backups within 90 days.

We keep payment records (your Paystack transaction reference, payment status, amount and date) for up to 6 years for accounting, tax and payment-dispute purposes. We may also keep limited information for longer where the law requires it or where we need it to establish, exercise or defend legal claims. Support messages are kept for up to 24 months after the issue is resolved. Crash logs are kept for up to 90 days and analytics for up to 14 months, after which they are deleted or anonymised.

Deleting your account ends your access to premium features. It does not cancel or refund a completed payment on its own, so please read our Refund & Cancellation Policy. If you have an unresolved payment issue, contact theoremacademia@gmail.com before you delete your account so we can find your transaction. If you want your account deleted, you do not need to wait for a payment issue to be resolved. Tell us and we will handle the payment record separately.

You can also ask us to give you a copy of your personal data, correct it, restrict or stop certain processing, or withdraw your consent, including to promotional messages. Email theoremacademia@gmail.com from your account address. We may ask for information we reasonably need to verify the request and protect your account. We will respond within 30 days. If you are unhappy with our response, you can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC).
Privacy and support email: theoremacademia@gmail.com. WhatsApp: 0814 913 2093. Operator: TheoremAcademia.

x: share, sell or lend your account access;
attempt to access another student’s account or data;
bypass premium locks or payment verification;
manipulate exam results or analytics;
scrape, mass-download, redistribute or commercially resell protected study content without permission;
reverse-engineer, attack or overload the service;
upload malicious material;

use the app to cheat in a live examination.

blocks.x: Keep your password and verification links private. Sign out on shared devices. Tell theoremacademia@gmail.com if you suspect unauthorised access.

Report suspected abuse, security issues or unauthorised content sharing to theoremacademia@gmail.com. Please include enough detail for us to investigate, but do not send passwords or other secret credentials.

We may investigate suspected violations and restrict or suspend accounts where reasonably necessary to protect users, content or the service, subject to applicable law. Serious or repeated violations may lead to permanent termination under our Terms of Service.

Cookies are small files stored by a browser. Similar technologies may store or read information on a device.

Our website at theoremacademia.com does not set cookies or use similar tracking technologies. We do not use advertising cookies or analytics cookies on the website, and it does not embed third-party content that sets cookies.

Like most websites, our hosting provider, Vercel, may process basic technical request data, such as your IP address and browser type, in server logs so the site can be delivered and kept secure. This is not used to track you across other sites.
The Theorem app is different from the website. See our Privacy Policy for how the app stores data on your device and which analytics and crash-reporting tools it uses.

Because the website does not use non-essential cookies, there is nothing to switch off. You can still manage or block cookies in your browser settings at any time. If we add any non-essential cookies in future, we will update this policy and ask for your consent before setting them.

We may update this policy if our website technologies change. The current version is available at https://www.theoremacademia.com/legal/cookie-policy. Contact theoremacademia@gmail.com with questions.
